# langfuse_user (Data Source)

Look up a member of the organization by email address through the SCIM API, for example to obtain the user ID for an annotation queue assignment. Requires an organization-scoped API key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "organization_public_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "organization_private_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

data "langfuse_user" "reviewer" {
  organization_public_key  = var.organization_public_key
  organization_private_key = var.organization_private_key
  email                    = "reviewer@example.com"
}

output "reviewer_id" {
  value = data.langfuse_user.reviewer.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) The email address of the user.
- `organization_private_key` (String, Sensitive) The organization private key used to authenticate API calls.
- `organization_public_key` (String, Sensitive) The organization public key used to authenticate API calls.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The user ID.
- `name` (String) The display name of the user.
